The *Anāgatavāra* is a canonical Abhidhamma text forming a subsection of the *Yamaka* (catalogued as Ya 10.3.3), the sixth treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [catalog record; SuttaCentral]. As designated by its title, the section applies the dialectical question-and-answer method of the *Yamaka* to phenomena in the future temporal domain (*anāgata*) [catalog record; SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation in one language for this text [SuttaCentral].
